name: Baptizing Children
overview: Scripture affirms the value and inclusion of children in the kingdom of heaven, as Jesus welcomed them and emphasized their place in His kingdom (Matthew 19:14). The Great Commission commands making disciples and baptizing all nations in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Matthew 28:18-19), underscoring the importance of baptism as a public declaration of faith. Salvation is closely tied to belief and baptism (Mark 16:16), and entrance into God's kingdom requires being born of water and the Spirit (John 3:5), highlighting the spiritual necessity of baptism. While Jesus baptized with the Holy Spirit (Mark 1:8), the application of baptism to children must be understood within the context of genuine faith and the teaching mandate given to all nations.
